title: onPostCreate rejects an unexpected payload with no log
current: If the post-create trigger body has no post id, the route returns 400 and logs nothing. The invalid mod-action branch, by contrast, logs internal_trigger_failed.
evidence: A change in the trigger payload shape would silently stop community post activity from being recorded. Onboarding reads that activity (see #245), so the effect would show up far from the cause.
required: A warn diagnostic on the 400 branch naming the payload keys that were present (no content).

criticality.why: Silent loss of an onboarding input if Reddit's payload ever changes.
